title: Publication package prepared
detail: The verified notebook package connects 111 research questions, 2,863 recorded runs with original log snapshots, 54 report figures, 201 numeric tables, and 291 source files. Historical source associations were audited; the unavailable bin/agree2.py reference remains flagged on MT111. The registered CVK2 result remains unresolved, with cuts 16, 19 and 22 in the peak set.

detail: The notebook and original research repositories are public. Code and versioned evidence can be read without invitations. The hosted notebook retains its private group access.

title: Six new results from 15-16 September added to the register
detail: Six rows appended to the campaign's MASTER-TABLE (lines 212-217, CORRECTIONS 217-226) are now records MT212-MT217, each with its registered verdict. MT212 (cgn1): the scalar-to-layerwise gap also appears on a GroupNorm ResNet-18, which has no batch statistics; GAP-REPLICATES, Goal met. MT213 (cpl1): on a ResNet-18 with its residual additions removed, the isolated BN-scale pair rescues accuracy but layer4.0.bn2.weight alone does not; HEAD-CARRIES-PLAIN, Mixed. MT214 (cvh1): the VGG isolation rescue is unchanged at 328 epochs; RESCUE-SURVIVES, Goal met. MT215 (cuc1): without augmentation on CIFAR-100, tuned SGD still beats the best MetaOptimize cell, by +12.18 pp; DEFICIT-HOLDS, Goal met. MT216 (cgn2): on GroupNorm ResNet-18 the three BatchNorm carrier tensors still rescue and a matched set does not; IDENTITY-TRANSFERS-GN, Goal met. MT217 (cpl2): on the residual-free network layer4.1.bn2.weight alone rescues and its twin does not; HEAD-CARRIES-ALONE-PLAIN, Goal met. All six are linked to the new research phase for 15-16 Sep 2026. Their 93 runs are not yet in the run inventory, so these records link no run logs. The register CSV download now lists all 154 records with separate outcome, kind and Corrected columns. Existing experiment IDs and outcomes are unchanged.

title: Fairness audit moves to Goal met; runs for MT212-MT217 linked
detail: MT019, the fairness audit, moves from Open to Goal met: CORRECTIONS 229 moved MASTER-TABLE row 19 to CONFIRMED, RESCOPED after cau1 (CIFAR-10, +3.6173 pp) and cuc1 (CIFAR-100, +12.1780 pp) closed its two remaining counts. Its limits stay in its scope: one baseline family, the paper's alpha0 1e-6 untested on CIFAR-100, and one granularity per batch. The previous outcome and wording are kept in a warning. MT020, MT163, MT164 and MT213 keep their outcomes and gain the amendment notes from the same entry. The 93 runs of cgn1, cpl1, cvh1, cuc1, cgn2 and cpl2 now link to MT212-MT217 with sanitized raw logs, for 2,956 runs in total. Research outcomes are now 46 Goal met, 41 Goal missed, 26 Mixed and 23 Open.

title: cvt1 imported as MT218 (Mixed), 15 runs linked
detail: MT218 imports the cvt1 row from MASTER-TABLE line 218 (CORRECTIONS 230). Its verdict is STEP-SIZE-NEEDED-VOTE-SUFFICES, and every gate passed. Under the notebook's outcome rules it is Mixed: the registered account missed INJECT's 8-30 band (INJECT 30.14). MUTE, DOSE and INJECT are vote-weight interventions (VOTE_W), not plain scalar or HEAD arms. Their 9 runs are marked on the run pages and listed in results/CORPUS-EXCLUSIONS.tsv. The 15 runs link to MT218 with sanitized raw logs, for 2,971 runs in total. Research outcomes are now 46 Goal met, 41 Goal missed, 27 Mixed and 23 Open.

title: cgn3 imported as MT219 (Goal met), 12 runs linked; MT213 and MT218 amended
detail: MT219 imports the cgn3 row from MASTER-TABLE line 219 (CORRECTIONS 231). Its verdict is RESCUE-SURVIVES (RHO 1.2235), and the registered scorer passed 87 gates with 0 failures. Under the notebook's outcome rules it is Goal met: every arm and RHO land in the tested FREEZE-HOLDS account's registered bands. Two limits stay on the record: ISO's level settled before its complement pinned, and ISO ends 3.02 pp below kL at 430 epochs (CEIL-BELOW). The 12 runs are 430-epoch runs and link to MT219 with sanitized raw logs, for 2,983 runs in total. The same commit amended rows 213 and 218 in place: MT213 now records that cvt1 landed (MT218), and MT218 keeps its claim that every cell-pooling reader drops the 9 intervention rows only as superseded wording: no analysis file imports the exclusion list, and at least one reader pools those rows. No outcome changed. Research outcomes are now 47 Goal met, 41 Goal missed, 27 Mixed and 23 Open.

title: cvt3 and cvt2 imported as MT220 and MT221 (both Mixed), 36 runs linked
detail: MT220 imports the cvt3 row and MT221 the cvt2 row, from MASTER-TABLE lines 220-221 (CORRECTIONS 235 and 236). cvt3 returned OWN-STEP-NECESSARY: silencing layer4.1.bn2.weight and its 20-tensor DOWN coalition on one shared step size leaves the scalar arm at k01. cvt2 returned GRADED + TOP-ATTENUATED: the injected collapse is graded in K, and cvt1's 0.344 residue falls to 0.256 at K2000. Under the notebook's outcome rules both are Mixed, as MT218 was. cvt3's own account misses its MUTECTL band by 0.18 pp. For cvt2, no registered account predicted this result and the stated TOP-FLAT prior missed by 0.26 pp. The 24 vote-weight intervention runs (MUTE50, MUTEDOWN, MUTECTL; K13-K2000) are marked on their run pages and listed in results/CORPUS-EXCLUSIONS.tsv. The 36 runs link to their records with sanitized raw logs, for 3,019 runs in total. In-place amendments with no outcome change: MT216 (CORRECTIONS 234, ISO above kL held at 100 epochs only) and MT213 (CORRECTIONS 236, 'whoever casts it' corrected to the one caster that was run). Research outcomes are now 47 Goal met, 41 Goal missed, 29 Mixed and 23 Open.

title: cvt4 and cvt5 imported as MT222 and MT223 (both Goal met), 30 runs linked
detail: MT222 imports the cvt4 row and MT223 the cvt5 row, from MASTER-TABLE lines 222-223 (CORRECTIONS 240 and 241). cvt4 returned OWN-STEP-MAGNITUDE: with layer4.1.bn2.weight's vote out of the complement's sum, holding its own step size large (a replay of MUTE's trajectory) stalls the arm at k01, and holding it at the floor keeps HEAD's level (P_HIGH +53.61 pp = +94.55 SE). cvt5 returned K-DEPENDENT-EQUILIBRIUM, RESCUE-SURVIVES and K33-HOLDS-PINNED: at 300 epochs K13 holds 15.95 pp above K33, so cvt2's GRADED is not a delay; HEAD's PlainNet rescue survives its complement's pin (RHO 1.0012); K33 stays pinned. Under the notebook's outcome rules both are Goal met, as MT219 was: each registered branch answers its question and the tested account is in band on every registered band (9 for cvt4, 8 for cvt5). The bounds stay on the records. For cvt4, HOLDHIGH's complement collapsed too, so a direct stall is not separated from one through the complement, and there is no time gate or dose curve. For cvt5, the level-holds stamps sit only 0.96-1.34 pp inside READ_BAR, K13's step size hovers near the floor rather than freezing, and K13's level settled before its pin. The 18 intervention runs (cvt4's step-size holds HOLDLOW, HOLDSHARED, HOLDHIGH and HOLDHEAD; cvt5's vote weights K13 and K33) are marked on their run pages and listed in results/CORPUS-EXCLUSIONS.tsv. The 30 runs link to their records with sanitized raw logs, for 3,049 runs in total. No existing row was amended. Separately, MT215's text no longer shows Markdown escapes: S* and M* were shown with a stray backslash before the star, and some stars had been lost. Research outcomes are now 49 Goal met, 41 Goal missed, 29 Mixed and 23 Open.
